primary.question: A: direction conditional on nonzero forward return
primary.endpoint: 1s frozen OBI Balanced Accuracy and paired BA gain versus original training-majority baseline
primary.secondary: 5s/10s, other original models, Accuracy/AUC/matrices and paired gains; same labels and filters
primary.models: Unchanged saved parameters, preprocessing, feature order, C=1/lbfgs, threshold0.5; no fit
primary.timing: Original1s receipt as-of, lag[0,2]s, receipt age<=2s, complete valid path, exact1/5/10s endpoints; no crossing sessions/dates
primary.uncertainty: Original paired clock blocks30/60/120s and origin/half-block shifts,1000 replicates;60s main; no day bootstrap
primary.coverage: Valid features/all grid states; valid forward labels/possible grid pairs; nonzero-label fraction is outcome coverage, not decision coverage

exploratory.question: B: information and decisions over all admissible labels, including unchanged prices
exploratory.policies: Existing p>=0.5 forced up/down; fixed p>0.6 up,p<0.4 down,otherwise abstain; all-time original-training majority (flat) baseline
exploratory.interpretation: p remains conditional-on-move; not an unconditional probability. Abstention coded0 only for descriptive three-action agreement, not a fitted flat-probability model
exploratory.coverage: Ex-ante policy activity/valid feature states and activity/valid labels; direction-only subset is retrospective and separately identified
exploratory.metrics: All-label up-vs-not-up rank AUC (not calibration), fixed three-class agreement/macro recall, unconditional quantile mean returns and up/down/zero probabilities; block intervals
exploratory.magnitude: Five original-training all-label OBI-bin mean returns; separate exploratory lookup, not Logistic expected-return output
exploratory.cost: Compare abs(training-bin forecast) and realized signed mid changes with current full spread_bps; hypothetical additional round-trip cost0/1/5bps; no fills/PnL
exploratory.delay: Original features at t, benchmark log M(t+1+h)/M(t+1); both benchmark source receive AND exchange timestamps strictly after t; valid entire t..t+1+h path; no model/decision change
exploratory.regimes: Original training spread_bps,lag,past60s-vol medians; also original-training absolute-spread median; no holdout-derived cutoffs
exploratory.small_sessions: Report all sessions; additional sensitivity excluding sessions with fewer than100 nonzero1s labels in prior seen data; diagnostic, not winning-sample selection
exploratory.uncertainty: Session-date-stratified60s paired time-block bootstrap for all-time moments; no between-day generalization or multiplicity-adjusted claim

history: Primary and exploratory rules fixed before first final-holdout disclosure; after first scoring this holdout is permanently seen, even on replay
